name: Holiday Slow-Roasted Prime Rib Roast with Beef Au Jus & Soft Potatoes
searchKeywords: prime rib au jus christmas dinner
whyItWorks: Slow roasting dissolves collagen into tender, succulent beef that requires minimal chewing. Dipped in savory au jus with smooth peeled potatoes, it is a low-residue luxury.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request a center cut of prime rib cooked medium; trim the outer fat cap before eating (pass on spicy creamy horseradish).
watchOuts: Avoid pungent raw horseradish sauce which can burn mucosal tissue
